bifrost: bifrost_app::defaults, coding, file_coordination, file_manager, fswatch, workspace, quicksearch, document; bifrost_ui::metaquery; docbroker file grants
summary: Settings, JSON and plist coding, file coordination, change events, a FileManager-style item API (copy, move, remove, attributes, enumeration), metadata predicates over file records and Spotlight-style indexing have SDK APIs. There is no keyed archiver or binary plist, no FileWrapper, no iCloud, and no file-system-wide metadata query.

features.feature: File System (create, read, write, examine files)
features.apple: FileManager, FileHandle, URL file APIs, FileWrapper, bookmarks
features.note: NativeFileManager covers existence and kind, attributes (kind, size, modified), shallow and deep listings, directory creation, copy, move and remove for files, links and trees, with refusal of existing destinations. Apps outside the portal grants still work only in their data dir. No FileWrapper, no bookmarks or security-scoped URLs, no link creation, no extended attributes, no progress callbacks.
Advisory flock; no relinquish or move negotiation, no versions.
Recursive inotify stream with latency and a SHALLOW flag.
Recycle uses the shared Recently Deleted folder with Put Back.

features.feature: Archives and Serialization: JSON and property lists
features.note: JSON and XML plist only; no binary plist, Data unsupported, few strategies.
Codable-style traits exist; no keyed archive format.
Typed get/set and register(defaults:); no change-observation across processes noted.
One restorable window per app, JSON file.
Per-app JSON index, capped at 1000 items.
Predicates on name, extension, kind, size and modification time, combined with all, any and not; sorted and limited. The caller supplies the records; no file-system-wide query and no live updates.
Apple iCloud service; BifrOSt Cloud backups/sync are separate and not an SDK file API.
Memory caches purge on pressure; no on-disk purgeable or backup exclusion flags.

gaps: FileWrapper (bundles of files), bookmarks and security-scoped URLs for apps outside the portal grants
Symbolic link creation, extended attributes and copy progress in the FileManager-style API
File-system-wide metadata query with live updates
iCloud / cloud-synced documents and key-value store
Backup exclusion and on-disk purgeable data
